title: Package repository credential stored in a committed file
description: auth.json declares a literal repository password in `auth.json`. A secret committed in this file is readable by everyone with repository access and lives on in history after removal. This rule reads a literal repository password in `auth.json`.
remediation: Remove the literal, rotate the credential and inject it from the CI secret store at run time. Specifically: fix a literal repository password in `auth.json`.
limitation: It matches a literal repository password in `auth.json` in the parsed auth.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
